leading_hypothesis: Generation fencing is sufficient to keep the new single-host UnifiedDB-to-ClayGraph projection lease effectively single-active even when the host realtime clock changes discontinuously.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Because projection_worker_v1_candidate.py derives lease expiry from time.time_ns()/CLOCK_REALTIME, a forward realtime discontinuity can make a still-live lease appear expired after only a tiny monotonic interval. A contender can then acquire a newer generation before the intended lease duration has elapsed; generation fencing only reacts after takeover.

fresh_external_evidence.claim_used: The time clock is adjustable and time.time/time_ns is backed by CLOCK_REALTIME where available; CLOCK_REALTIME can have discontinuities when system time changes. Python exposes a separate monotonic clock for interval measurement.
time.monotonic() cannot go backwards and is not affected by system clock updates; CLOCK_BOOTTIME is a suspend-aware monotonic Linux clock.

go_oob_experiment.name: PROJECTION_LEASE_REALTIME_FORWARD_STEP
go_oob_experiment.sensitivity_control: With only 10 ms elapsed and no realtime discontinuity, contender B must receive LEASE_HELD.
go_oob_experiment.intervention: Keep logical elapsed at 10 ms but present the current lease arithmetic with a +10000 ms realtime step.

supported_now: The current lease arithmetic is sensitive to an injected realtime forward discontinuity in a faithful local mechanism reproduction.
Generation fencing correctly invalidates the old holder after a newer generation is acquired.
Therefore generation fencing and expiry-clock correctness are separate safety properties.
not_yet_supported: Accepted Hostinger target reproduction of PR #400.
Any claim that real host clock stepping has occurred in production.
Multi-host lease safety, power-loss durability or whole Frank v0.1 acceptance.

architecture_delta.unifieddb_claygraph_projection_worker: Do not promote clock-step-safe single-active scheduling from the current realtime-expiry lease until the accepted-target discriminator is executed and a successor clock/boot policy is tested.
architecture_delta.candidate_successor_direction_not_select: Evaluate same-boot monotonic or CLOCK_BOOTTIME expiry with explicit boot identity so restart/reboot semantics remain explicit; retain generation fencing as an independent stale-worker fence.
architecture_delta.rollback: Diagnostic-only branch/PR can be closed with no product rollback because no worker implementation changed.

duplicate_work_avoided: WAL/main-file snapshot pairing was already covered by PRs #286/#296 and was not rebuilt.
Concurrent shadow-load was already covered by PR #392 and was not duplicated.
Older V15 presence clock/recovery work was treated as related ancestry, not as proof for the new projector lease.
